provisionalNotice: PROVISIONAL (pre-freeze). Not an offer, qualification or gate result; nothing here enables a cell, selects an allowance or changes a default.
note: The profile is wall-clock time of one instrumented native request: an attribution run, not a timing run. Finder and apply times include the cost of their own timers (estimated in overhead.json).

registry.note: the nine finders of IG-S03's implemented scopes (singles and the six naked/hidden pair, triple and quad finders) against every other registered finder of this source; variant-scoped finders (cage, inequality) run only on their variants

cells.inclusiveEqualsExclusive: a finder call never contains another timed frame (finders call no solve, no DFS and no other finder), so its inclusive and exclusive times are the same number; the stage tables hold the rest of the solver as its own cells (never summed twice)

bound.note: Ceilings, not forecasts: each removes the named wall time completely at zero cost from this profiled run (finder time includes its timers). A negative scan (a call that found nothing) is the only time a scoped cache can skip; how much of it a cache could skip depends on invalidation rates that this profile does not measure.

chainGroup.note: forcingChain and nishio work on cloned trial states, so their footprint is the whole grid state, not a unit or a cell

bound.measuredPartialS3Note: IG-S03 scoped-native-w1 against IG-S02 native-w1 for this very request (n = 1, time-separated, within the machine noise of a few percent); it covers the nine implemented finders only and is not extrapolated to the rest

biasAdjusted.note: each finder call is charged the calibrated cost of one clock read (the part of the timer pair inside the measured interval)
